notes.text: The source states that the writer spent three years in the institution while unaware of its financing arrangement, calls that financing profondément immoral et extrêmement dangereux, says he will leave the IHES on 30 Septembre prochain, and suspends scientific collaboration while the subventions continue. These are reported source statements, not independently verified historical claims.

The source says Monsieur L. Motchane agreed that from 1er Octobre 1970 the IHES would stop distributing the specified mathematical texts. It says the seminar will be distributed by Julius Springer in Lecture Notes, and thanks Springer and K. Peters for help with publication and photooffset typing.
